description: Defines an immutable data class 'Note' with properties related to a note object, including copyWith, equality, and hashCode implementations.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: An immutable class representing a note with properties such as id, title, content, timestamps, and flags for deletion and modification status.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Note instance with optional new values for its fields.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Overrides equality operator to compare the content of two Note instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode to produce a unique hash based on the Note's properties.
